subject: Glaive's Airship
text: Stepping on the upper right switch after defeating the werewolves opens the left fence, and stepping on the upper left switch reveals a ladder.

evidence.quote: Here, kill all the werewolves on the left side first. After killing all of them, step on the switch on the upper right. This will open the fence on the left side. Now, step on the upper left switch. A ladder will appear.

subject: Sumo
text: Julius blasts you from the window of the airship, causing you to fall down.

evidence.quote: Now, go all the way to the right and you’ll see Fuji on the window. But, Julius will come in and blasts you! You will try to hang on but to no avail, you will still fall down.

subject: Chocobo
text: Examining the egg causes it to hatch into a Chocobo that follows you as a new NPC and gives you a ride where enemies cannot harm you.

evidence.quote: Examine the egg and it will hatch. It’s a Chocobo! It will follow you because it thinks that you are its mother. You now have a New NPC, the Chocobo! If you ASK, it will give you a ride. You’ll be much faster and safer because enemies cannot harm you if you are on a chocobo.

subject: Gecko
text: Geckos living in the desert rarely drop Fangs.

evidence.quote: You can get fangs from the Gecko’s living in the desert. It’s very rarely though, that they drop these item.

subject: Cave of Medusa
text: Giving Fangs to the kid near the Item Shop in Jadd reveals the clue, and walking around the two palm trees in a pattern like an 8 opens the Cave of Medusa.

evidence.quote: If you got one, bring it back to the kid near the Item Shop in Jadd. It will give you the clue to the Cave of Oasis....Walk around the trees making a pattern like an 8,just as in the diagram. If done correctly, the Cave of Medusa will now open.

subject: Cave of Medusa
text: A Gold Armor is found inside the Cave of Medusa.

evidence.quote: Now, go left one screen and then go south one screen. You’ll get a Gold Armor.

subject: Cave of Medusa
text: Using your chain at the pole across the slippery floor switch allows you to enter the newly opened door and receive the Magic Book of Ice.

evidence.quote: You’ll be taken to the switch which will open the right door. Now, use your chain at the pole at once, then go right one screen through the newly opened door. Here, you’ll receive the Magic Book of Ice.

subject: Ice Magic
text: Using Ice Magic on a spider turns it into a controllable moving snowman that can be pushed onto a switch to open the north door.

evidence.quote: Now, use your newly gained Ice Magic on one of the spiders. It will turn into a snowman! Take note that YOU CAN CONTROL the ice as it travels!...After turning one of the spiders into a snowman, push it to the switch. The north door will now open.

subject: Medusa
text: Medusa yields 92 EXP and 70 GP, and the Chain is the preferred weapon against her.

evidence.quote:
EXP gained:         92
GP:                 70...Preferred Weapon:   Chain

subject: Medusa
text: Medusa attacks by throwing snakes that inflict the Ston status, which Amanda can cure if asked, while you attack Medusa's head.

evidence.quote: To defeat Medusa, you have to hit her head as many times as you could....She only has 1 attack. She will throw snakes at you! Try to avoid these as they can inflict the Ston status. Don’t worry though. If you got Stoned, just ask amanda and she’ll heal you.

subject: Amanda
text: After Amanda is bitten by Medusa, killing her allows you to obtain the Tears of Amanda.

evidence.quote: When you regain control of Sumo, kill Amanda (you can’t move on to the story if you don’t do this). After killing her, go to her and you’ll get the Tears of Amanda.

subject: Lester
text: Equipping Amanda's Tear and examining the parrot frees Lester from Davias' curse, recruiting him as an NPC who changes the music when asked.

evidence.quote: Now, you’ll see a parrot here. It is Amanda’s Brother. So, equip Amanda’s Tear and examine the parrot. Lester will now be freed from Davias’ Curse. He will now join you to avenge Amanda as a NPC. If you ask Lester, he will change the music for you.

subject: Davias' Mansion
text: Stepping on the floor panels in the specified diagram order causes a ladder to appear to reach the next area.

evidence.quote: The key here is to step on the panels in order....Doing this, a ladder will appear and you can go to the next area.

subject: Davias' Mansion
text: Pushing an enemy turned into a snowman onto the switch unlocks the door, where defeating all enemies awards the Were Axe.

evidence.quote: You must step on the switch to open the door. So, in short, use your Ice Magic on one of the enemies and push the snowman onto the switch. Once the door is open, go in. The door will automatically lock. Defeat all the enemies and you’ll get the Were Axe.

subject: Davias
text: Davias yields 100 EXP and 103 GP, and the Chain Flail is recommended against him.

evidence.quote:
EXP gained:         100
GP:                 103...Preferred Weapon:   Chain...First, I suggest you use the Chain Flail again.

subject: Davias
text: You can use your weapon to attack Davias's fireballs, excluding the fireballs protecting him.

evidence.quote: Tip: You can use your weapon to attack the Fireballs (excluding the fireballs around Davias)

subject: Jadd
text: Before leaving Jadd, Lester gives you the Magic book of Mute.

evidence.quote: Before leaving, Lester will give you the Magic book of Mute.

subject: Lester
text: Lester plays a tune that removes the poison gas to the north.

evidence.quote: Lester’s tune will remove the poison gas to the north (if you went there earlier).

subject: Metal Crab
text: Metal Crab gives 107 EXP and 101 GP, and the Wind Spear is the ideal weapon to hit its mouth.

evidence.quote:
EXP gained:         107
GP:                 101...Preferred Weapon:   Wind Spear...To damage it, you must hit its mouth so the Wind Spear is the ideal weapon for this.

subject: Metal Crab
text: Staying in the middle and walking opposite to where the Metal Crab moves keeps you safe when it moves up or down.

evidence.quote: Just stay in the middle and always walk to the opposite of where the Metal Crab is going. This way, when he moves up or down, you won’t get hurt.
